node.title: Re: pipe issue (linux)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [leostereo],

What happens if you pipe the first script to another process (like grep) and then wait a while? If you get output in a large chunk after a wait, you're probably [http://perl.plover.com/FAQs/Buffering.html|Suffering from Buffering]. Add a [doc://perlvar#$OUTPUT_AUTOFLUSH|$|=1;] at the top of dhcp_line_dispacher.pl to see if it helps.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
